settings.title: Your map
settings.body: The board is your trail from the shore all the way to freedom. Each glowing marker is a course. Finish one and the path lights up to the next — so you always see how far you've come, not just how far there is to go.
settings.tip: Locked markers unlock automatically as you clear the courses before them.
settings.bonus: The lit-up trail isn't just decoration — it's your progress made visible. Watch it grow as you go.

settings.title: Opening a course
settings.body: Tap any glowing marker to open it. Inside, work through the lessons and mark each one complete. When you finish every lesson, the course is done — you earn points, your certificate is ready, and the trail unlocks ahead.
settings.tip: You can revisit any finished course anytime — nothing ever locks back up.
settings.bonus: Every completed course hands you a certificate you can download, print, or re-view later from Milestones.

settings.title: All Courses
settings.body: The All Courses tab lists every course across all five realms, grouped by realm with your progress on each. Jump straight to any course — no need to remember where it lives on the map.
settings.tip: Each realm shows a little progress bar so you can see what's left at a glance.
settings.bonus: In a hurry? This is the fastest way back to the exact course you left off on.

settings.title: Your Progress
settings.body: The Progress tab shows your courses done, points, badges, day streak and Merit rank. Tap any tile to see the details behind it — which courses you've finished, where your points came from, your badge collection, a streak calendar, and the full tier ladder.
settings.tip: Tap the Points tile for a breakdown of exactly where every point came from.
settings.bonus: The Merit tile opens the full 20-rank ladder — Dreamer all the way to Unbound — with how close you are to the next rank.

settings.title: Bonus Checks
settings.body: Between courses, the Bonuses tab has quick Mindset, Purpose and Heart check-ins. They're never locked and never required — just short pulse-checks to keep you steady and earn a few points.
settings.tip: Dip in whenever you need a reset — there's no wrong time and no penalty for skipping.
settings.bonus: Each check you complete adds points, so even a two-minute pause still moves you forward.

settings.title: Milestones & badges
settings.body: The Milestones page holds every badge you earn — realms cleared, framework masteries, streaks, reflections and special awards. Badges light up automatically as you hit each mark, with a little celebration.
settings.tip: Badges light up the moment you earn them — there's nothing to claim.
settings.bonus: Clear a whole realm, master a framework, or hold a long streak to unlock the rare ones. There are 45 in all.

settings.title: Journal
settings.body: The Journal is your private space for notes and reflections as you learn. Give entries titles, search them, and archive the ones you're done with. Your first entry each day earns points, too.
settings.tip: Give entries titles and use search to find them again later.
settings.bonus: Archived entries stay tucked away but recoverable for 60 days before they clear — nothing disappears on you.

settings.title: Daily Mindset Moment
settings.body: At the top of your journey, a fresh Mindset Moment appears every day — an affirmation, a verse, or a bit of motivation to start you off right. It rotates automatically at midnight.
settings.tip: A new one is waiting each morning — no refresh needed.
settings.bonus: Drawn from a library of 500 affirmations, verses, and quotes, so it stays fresh for well over a year.

settings.title: Streaks & weekly goal
settings.body: Show up each day to build a streak — and don't worry, one missed day is forgiven so a long run survives a slip. There's also a gentle weekly goal: finish a course this week for a bonus. Small, steady momentum.
settings.tip: Miss a day? A single slip is forgiven, so a long streak won't vanish overnight.
settings.bonus: Hit your weekly goal and the bonus lands automatically — there's no button to press.

settings.title: Your Journey Recap
settings.body: Tap See my Journey Recap on the Progress tab for a shareable snapshot of your stats — your rank, points, courses done, badges, longest streak and days active. Screenshot it to share how far you've come.
settings.tip: Screenshot it to share your progress with a friend or your community.
settings.bonus: It updates live, so every time you open it, it reflects exactly where you are right now.
